Subject: Update on your application for the Marketing position

Dear [Candidate Name],

Thank you for giving us the opportunity to review your application for the Marketing position. We truly appreciate the time and effort you invested in the process.

After careful consideration, we have decided to move forward with other candidates whose experience more closely aligns with our current needs. Please know that this decision was not a reflection of your skills or potential; rather, it was a matter of finding the specific fit we are looking for at this time.

We were impressed by your background and wish you the very best in your job search and future professional endeavors.

Sincerely,

[Your Name]
[Your Title]
